name: PracticeTakes
description: Practice Takes is an early-stage desktop music-practice application for Windows, Linux, and macOS, built with JUCE 8 and C++20, currently offering a tuner and spectrogram over a shared microphone-capture shell. It also includes a small TypeScript Cloudflare Worker that receives in-app feedback submissions. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
